applies_why: The judge text addresses whether C4's verse pressed against a dropped link counts, which is the counting issue the rule governs.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge treats the pressed verse as directed at a dropped limb and does not count it as an unanswered witness against a live link, so it obeys K-G4.
